<!--
Release notes template for WOSM.

How to use:
- Copy this file to .github/release-notes/<tag>.md using the release tag as the file
  name, for example v0.2.2.md.
- Fill in every language section and remove placeholder bullets you do not need.
- The release workflow uses the file verbatim as the GitHub release body and appends
  the "Full Changelog" line automatically; do not add one yourself.
- Keep the section order and headings so release pages stay consistent.
-->
